Name: Claire Dunn
Details: We’ve entered what Frances Weller calls ‘The Long Dark’ - the collapse times. What might  Rewilding and Deep Nature Connection practices offer us in terms of resource, regenerating culture… and potentially sometime in the future, surviving. This will be a head, heart and hands hour. And contrary to what the blurb suggests, not depressing.

Name: Jordhana Clark
Details: An embodied exploration of our relationship to The Inner Beloved. A deep, rich love affair that is available to us all the time. Come and cultivate the most secure attachment that you will ever know.

Name: Kat Daymond
Details: A safely held space for people to deeply connect using authentic relating and conscious connection methods. Using connection methods and activities such as eye gazing, co-regulating and powerful questions, attendees are led through a journey, becoming more connected to themselves, deeply connected to others and leaving feeling like they’re in a bubble of love.

Name: Shanti Banfai
Workshop name: Qigong for heart-opening, healing and awakening
Details: Combining several practices including qigong, meditation and shaking, this workshop will leave you feeling relaxed, grounded and connected to your inner capacity for self-healing. All welcome.

Name: Josanne Broersen
Details: Biodanza: Experience the freedom of movement to dance and move to music chosen especially for the theme. Be in the here and now in connection with yourself, others and the group dynamic.

Name: Victoria Whelan
Details: Collaborative vocal improv is a practice where you explore singing in a free and the way. Co Creating. Amazing music together using some simple and accessible exercises

Name: Chris Stewart
Details: We’ll use Futures Studies to reflect on scenarios we (un)consciously hold & define our best paths into whatever happens. Bring your thinking caps, & joy in sharing, & lets find our future priorities!

Name: DJ SoundGuy (Aeron Saks)
Details: Free-form moving meditation dance journey

Name: Stacia Karina Beazley
Details: As we evolve, so does our relationship to Feelings. Anger exists FOR life & love, not against it. Join Stacia from The Art of Relating for a fun, embodied experience of Loving Anger.

Name: Jack Nicholls
Details: Jack, an arborist of 14 years, weaves baskets as a creative, mindful pushback against waste. His workshop invites you to reconnect with nature, embrace imperfection, and practice soft activism—creating gifts from Earth’s gifts. Slow down, explore, and collaborate with nature in a meaningful, hands-on way.

Name: Ana Strawberry
Details:
Hohoho Hahahaha Hehehehe... hihi hi... HAHAHAHAHAHA!

You might hear these joyful sounds drifting from a park, a hallway, or even across the hills. That’s Laughter Yoga — and you’re invited to join in

Name: Ian Richardson
Details:
Sunrise meditation of your choice.

I will open the space for 1 hour. Followed by a simple tea Ceremony, opening up the space for a talk on a topic such as 'Using Plants to support spiritual growth.

Name: Chelsea McNabb
Details:
Ever thought of living in community? Was your dream grounded in reality- something that might actually happen in this lifetime? 

Let’s dream together whilst grounding practicalities and real life.

Name: Katy Mixter
Details: Carve out some time to consider some of the most meaningful questions of life: what is my purpose and how do I align to it?

Name: Lisa Farinosi
Details: Start the day practicing vinyasa yoga to ground, centre, enhance vitality and open our hearts.

Name: Sarah Wilcox
Details: A creative, playful process of dreaming into our personal and collective goals, speaking from the future as if we have already embodied this reality to our current selves and sharing the steps we took

Name: Belle Taylor
Details: This unique experience energetically activates the Chong Mai (Life Purpose Meridian) helping you align with your soul path while receiving group Spinal Energetics

Name: Sabah
Details: Zen Flow invites you on an interactive journey where your body moves in its natural rhythm. Rooted in Zen Shiatsu, and Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), it promotes healing and balance.

Name: Maya Ward
Workshop name: Writing with the Earth: Kinship, Embodiment, Belonging
Details: Via guided meditations, embodiment processes and stream-of-consciousness writing, we enter into profound presence with the animate world; a transformative altered state process we call co-becoming.

Name: Jessi
Details: How to try without trying, how to play with how present you are and how to find your space within your comfort zone within your boundaries, in meditative ways, in connection with others.

Name: Anita Harding
Details: What to expect in 2025 for me. What’s my Personal year number, understanding the benefits and gifts of each number in the 9 year cycle. Learn how to calculate your year number and thrive in 2025.

Name: Isabelle Xavier
Details: A powerful relational meditation practice, Circling invites us into a collective communion with the present moment. A journey of embodied presence, authentic relating, surrender, and loving awareness.

Name: Katy Mixter
Details: In a held space, we will relax into a guided meditation to savour the beauty and insights we have received at the festival, and to envision how we want to take these insights back to our everyday

Name: Gabriel
Workshop name: Counteracting power concentration in governance models
Details: A facilitated community discussion of the challenges with compounding power concentrations in governance models and how we might build-in "power diffusion" into our new paradigms.

Name: Kaz T.Anderson
Workshop name: An Evolutionary Collective (pt 1): navigating trauma culture and community as medicine.
Details: What if the only pronouns were the plural pronouns 'Us' and 'We'? In this experience together we'll come curiously to ideas to help us create collective consciousness and language our evolution.

Name: Kaz T.Anderson
Workshop name: An Evolutionary Collective (pt 2): A Collective Communication practical experiment
Details: An experiment to explore an evolving version of NVC (Nonviolent Communication) that embraces collective-speak (soul, our needs) and is compassionate for individual-speak (I, me, my feelings, my needs)

Name: River Satya and Chloe McKeand
Workshop name: Vision for Evolve Community: a fireside chat
Details: Join Chloe and River for this podcast style conversation about the short and long-term vision for Evolve community.

Name: Chloe, Kate, Ari
Details: We will be creating a gentle ritual container for collective and individual grief to be welcomed, held, expressed and witnessed, possibly around a fire, fostering wholeness and connection.

Name: Regina Orchard
Workshop name: Music of the Plants Intro and Soundbath
Details: Learn about Plant Music Instruments, hear and feel into a selection of plants, ending with Nature's Soundbath.

Name: Regina Orchard
Workshop name: Feeling Into Plant Consciousness, Messages and Music
Details: A facilitated discussion for all to share their stories and heartfelt methods of communication with the plant kingdom. Supported by Music of the Plants. We will leave  with new perspectives and tools.

Name: Craig, Kate, Alexander and Chloe
Workshop name: Why are we here? What can we do?
Details: Responding to the meta-crisis - through connection, collective sense-making, inspiration and action.
